exposure: Ergonovine injection + spiral suture of the lower uterus
Conventional method + row suture of the lower uterus
outcome: Blood loss during and after cesarean section
cohort: 74 patients with pernicious placenta previa undergoing cesarean section
finding: The combined use of ergonovine and lower uterine spiral suture was effective in controlling hemorrhage in women with pernicious placenta previa undergoing cesarean section.
